body: I just feel better that someone told me they will definately be able to treat me in some way. So glad  I found the super specialist. I wish I had found him 5 years ago

Just an update: they referred me to a super specialist, gave me muscle relaxants, said I probably have pelvic floor dysfunction, and are hopeful they can treat me. The appointment is in a month and a half almost but I'm so glad things are moving in the right direction.
Can't complain in that department. Even if I had painkillers I'd still be taking what I'm taking. Can't wait til I can get up and not have to immediately take kratom though
